newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - slow end after busy week.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - slow end after busy week.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was slower after the rash of deals earlier in the week and prices were seen softer than the $140 and $141 fob NWE done mid-week.
"There's a few bits and pieces still around and prices are below $140, around $136-138," said one trader.

U.S. demand, which supported the market in much of September was not visible. High sulphur straight-run saw a M-100 selling at $120.50 cif ARA with offers heard two means flat. E-4 cargoes were lacking some popularity and assessed around a steady $129-131 cif NWE.
